app.name: Dovahkiin
app.tagline: A skill tree for your baby's first two years
hud.title: Title
node.hoverHint: Click or press Enter for details
today.label: Today · {age}
detail.noBabyNote: Start your baby's tree to mark skills as unlocked.
prompt.title: Also mark its prerequisites as unlocked?
prompt.body: {title} usually comes after these. Babies skip things all the time (some never crawl), so either answer is fine.
upnext.heading: Up next
upnext.readyEmpty: Nothing waiting right now. Enjoy the calm.
upnext.prepareEmpty: No prep quests right now. You're on top of it.
upnext.horizonEmpty: No keystones in the next {weeks} weeks.
onboarding.title: Start your baby's tree
onboarding.name: Baby's name or nickname
onboarding.nameHint: Optional. Only used in the copy.
onboarding.dueHint: Optional. Born early? If the due date is more than 2 weeks after birth, we'll use corrected age until 2 years.
onboarding.errorDob: Enter a valid date of birth.
onboarding.errorFuture: That date is in the future.
onboarding.errorDue: The due date needs to be within 20 weeks after the date of birth.
onboarding.beyondNote: The tree covers 0–24 months, so everything will be in view.
onboarding.privacy: Your baby's details and progress are saved only in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: This deletes your baby's details and all progress from this browser. Are you sure?
settings.noStorage: Progress won't be saved in this browser.
about.title: About
tree.help: Use the arrow keys to move between skills and Enter to open one. Escape closes the details.
notFound.title: Area not discovered
notFound.body: This part of the map hasn't been unlocked yet.
overview.heading: Skill families
overview.hint: Pick a family to zoom in. The tree grows upwards, from birth at the bottom to 24 months at the top. Each star marks when a skill can first appear, and the glow above it is the window most babies get there in.
focus.swipe: Swipe or use the arrows to move between families.
panel.label: About {name}
window.note: It's a window, not a deadline. Some get there sooner, some later, and every baby takes their own route.
window.before: The window hasn't opened yet. There's nothing to watch for until it does.
window.inside: Today sits inside the window. Any point in it is typical, near the start or near the end.
window.after: Past the usual window. Plenty of babies take longer or find another route, so take your time.
